Short introduction:
This demonstrates the basics of Github remote version control as well as some simple plotting of data set

##Git Basics

```{r}
library(readr)
cytotox <- read_csv("cytotox.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
mosaicplot(~Element+Cell_type,
           data=cytotox,
           col=c("blue", "green"),
           ylab = "Cell type",
           xlab = "Type of nanoparticle",
           las = 2,
           cex.axis = 0.6
           )
```

##GIT BASH

```{bash}
git init
git status
git add IVAMARGit.qmd
git add cytotox.csv
git commit -m "Add R Markdown report"
git remote add origin https://github.com/Sl1pyyy/Rbasics
git push -u origin main
```
